text: The Patriots head to Buffalo on Sunday for a crucial Week 4 matchup against the Bills looking decidedly undermanned on the defensive line, with Christian Gonzalez and Christian Barmore both ruled out due to shoulder injuries, leaving coordinator Mike Reiss to examine how New England will replace that production up front against Josh Allen's offense. In an attempt to shore up the secondary, the team elevated safety Mike Brown and cornerback Kindle Vildor from the practice squad to the active roster, though the squad is traveling with seven players listed as questionable heading into the game. On offense, the Patriots signed Romeo Doubs to a four-year deal back in March, but he's still searching for his footing in the scheme entering Week 4, while Matt Pryor is getting acclimated to the Patriots offense and Drake Maye continues to insist his right shoulder is fine despite the Patriots' early 1-2 record—with the quarterback emphasizing that better decision-making, not physical ailments, is what's needed to turn things around.
